quests.dispatcherQuestion: A ferry terminal reports smoke coming from beneath a docked passenger ferry's engine room. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what should happen to passengers right away.
quests.explanation: Evacuating immediately gets passengers off before smoke has a chance to turn into an open fire.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Firefighters need to know whether the fire is in the fuel system or the electrics. Input code!
quests.hint: Ask for the specialist crew trained for boat fires.
quests.explanation: A marine fire unit has training specific to fuel and electrical fires on board a vessel.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: The fire is out and engineers confirm the ferry's hull was not damaged. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what should happen to the disabled ferry.
quests.explanation: Towing it fully to dock lets engineers complete repairs without the ferry drifting or blocking the channel.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A large retail warehouse fire has firefighters worried about the roof's stability after twenty minutes. Input code!
quests.hint: Say the safety priority given the roof risk.
quests.explanation: Pulling crews out before a roof collapse is standard practice once the risk becomes too great to fight from inside.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: With crews outside, commanders decide to fight the fire from a safer distance instead. Input code!
quests.hint: Say the change in tactics needed for safety.
quests.explanation: Fighting the fire from outside the building keeps firefighters safe while still bringing the blaze under control.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: The roof has fully collapsed but no firefighters were inside when it happened. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what must be checked immediately after a collapse.
quests.explanation: An immediate headcount confirms the decision to pull crews out earlier kept everyone safe.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A school bus has broken down on a busy road during the morning school run. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what's needed to continue the children's journey safely.
quests.explanation: A replacement bus lets the children continue their journey without waiting on the roadside near traffic.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Until the replacement arrives, the children need to wait somewhere safer than the roadside. Input code!
quests.hint: Say where the children should wait instead.
quests.explanation: Moving behind a barrier keeps the children well clear of passing traffic while they wait.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: The replacement bus has arrived and all children are safely aboard and on their way. Input code!
quests.hint: Say who should be told the situation is resolved.
quests.explanation: Notifying parents promptly reassures them and explains why the bus may arrive a little later than usual.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A large public swimming pool reports a possible chemical imbalance causing swimmers to cough and gag. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what should happen to swimmers right away.
quests.explanation: Clearing the pool immediately stops more people breathing in whatever is causing the reaction.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Staff confirm chlorine gas built up after two cleaning chemicals were mixed by mistake. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what must be done to clear the air.
quests.explanation: Ventilating the hall lets the gas disperse safely before anyone is allowed back inside.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Air quality readings inside the pool hall are now confirmed safe by testing staff. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what can happen once the air is confirmed safe.
quests.explanation: Reopening only once readings are confirmed avoids sending swimmers back into air that still isn't fully safe.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A ski resort reports rising avalanche risk after heavy overnight snowfall on a popular run. Input code!
quests.hint: Say which part of the mountain must shut.
quests.explanation: Closing the higher slopes keeps skiers away from the exact area where the risk is greatest.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Ski patrol wants to trigger a controlled release before the slope becomes even more unstable. Input code!
quests.hint: Say the professional technique used to manage this risk.
quests.explanation: A controlled release lets patrol trigger a small, safe avalanche on their own terms, before a larger one happens by accident.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: The controlled release is complete and patrol confirms the slope is now stable. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what can happen once the slope is confirmed stable.
quests.explanation: Reopening the slopes once confirmed stable lets skiing safely resume for the rest of the day.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A large office building's water tank has burst, flooding the top three floors. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what must be stopped at the source.
quests.explanation: Shutting off the water supply stops the flooding from spreading to lower floors while repairs are made.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Water has begun dripping through ceiling tiles onto desks two floors below. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what should happen to workers directly below the leak.
quests.explanation: Moving staff away protects them from a ceiling that could sag or collapse under the weight of water.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Repairs are complete and an inspector confirms the affected floors are safe to use again. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what can happen once the floors are confirmed safe.
quests.explanation: Letting staff back in only after inspection avoids anyone returning to a still-damp, unsafe ceiling area.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A large delivery truck has jackknifed on a highway on-ramp, spilling its cargo of furniture. Input code!
quests.hint: Say exactly which part of the road must close.
quests.explanation: Closing just the on-ramp, rather than the whole highway, keeps traffic moving while still protecting the scene.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: The driver is trapped in the cab and cannot open his door to climb out. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what tool is needed to free him.
quests.explanation: Specialist cutting equipment can open the cab safely without pulling on a door that's jammed shut.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: The driver has been freed with only minor injuries and the ramp is being cleared. Input code!
quests.hint: Ask plainly for someone trained to treat them.
quests.explanation: Even minor injuries after being trapped in a cab should be properly checked by paramedics.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A large indoor food court's grease trap has caught fire, filling the mall with smoke. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what should happen to that section right away.
quests.explanation: Evacuating just the food court first gets people clear quickly while other mall areas remain calmer.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Smoke is now spreading toward the mall's main shopping level through open walkways. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what wider area now needs to be cleared too.
quests.explanation: Extending the evacuation as smoke spreads keeps shoppers ahead of the danger instead of reacting too late.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: The fire is fully out and air quality readings across the mall are back to normal. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what can happen once the mall is confirmed safe.
quests.explanation: Reopening only once readings are normal ensures shoppers and staff return to genuinely clean air.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A large public library reports a burst pipe is flooding the rare books archive. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what must be stopped at the source.
quests.explanation: Shutting off the water first stops any more damage to the irreplaceable archive materials.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Staff need to move the most valuable books away from the rising water quickly. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what needs to be moved, and to where implied.
quests.explanation: Relocating the books to higher, dry shelving is the fastest way to prevent permanent water damage.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: The leak is fixed and conservation staff confirm the rescued books were undamaged. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what final step completes the rescue.
quests.explanation: Returning the books once the room is dry and repaired completes the process safely.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A large multi-story car park's ground floor has flooded suddenly after a burst water main outside. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what should happen to that level right away.
quests.explanation: Evacuating the ground floor first protects anyone near the rising water while the main is shut off.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Several cars are now partly submerged and their owners are searching for them anxiously nearby. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what should be done with worried car owners.
quests.explanation: Keeping owners at a safe distance protects them from moving water while crews assess the flooded level.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: The water main is fixed and the ground floor has been fully pumped dry. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what must happen before any cars are allowed back.
quests.explanation: An inspection confirms the floor's structure and electrics are safe before drivers are allowed to collect their cars.
